concerns.text: FR-005 requires a mixed‑effects model with a three‑way interaction term (α × ε × is_minority). The implemented task T008b fits only two‑way interactions (α × ε and α × is_minority), leaving the three‑way term uncovered.

FR-009 mandates a power analysis to be performed *before* the full experimental sweep. No task in tasks.md performs a pre‑sweep power analysis; the only power‑related step (T006) is described as part of the orchestrator after the sweep, so the requirement is not satisfied.
